questions.q: Neither of the two candidates ____ eligible for the post.
questions.x: Correct answer: is. 'Neither' as a pronoun takes a singular verb.

questions.q: Select the synonym of the word 'Pragmatic'.
questions.x: 'Pragmatic' means practical. 'Idealistic' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
He prefers working / in the field / than sitting in the office.
questions.x: The error is in part (c): 'than sitting in the office'. 'Prefer A to B': 'to sitting in the office'.

questions.q: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to: FRIVOLOUS
questions.x: 'Frivolous' is the opposite of 'Serious'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Frivolous'.

questions.q: Choose the option that best expresses the meaning of the idiom: 'To put the cart before the horse'
o: To do things in the wrong order
questions.x: 'To put the cart before the horse' means: to do things in the wrong order.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
The cost of / these files / are high.
questions.x: The error is in part (c): 'are high'. The subject is 'cost' (singular): 'is high'.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'The study of ancient societies through material remains'
questions.x: 'Archaeology' means the study of ancient societies through material remains.

questions.q: Choose the option that best expresses the meaning of the idiom: 'To turn a blind eye'
questions.x: 'To turn a blind eye' means: to deliberately ignore something.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
Despite of the heavy rain, / the inspection team / reached the factory on time.
questions.x: The error is in part (a): 'Despite of the heavy rain'. 'Despite' is not followed by 'of'; use 'Despite the heavy rain' or 'In spite of'.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'A sum paid to an employee on leaving after long service'
questions.x: 'Gratuity' means a sum paid to an employee on leaving after long service.

questions.q: Why do decisions about rivers made in isolation create long disputes?
o: Because a river's changes in one area affect users elsewhere
Because courts refuse to hear cases
questions.x: Answer: 'Because a river's changes in one area affect users elsewhere'. The passage explains downstream effects across borders. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Rivers do not recognise administrative borders. A dam built in one State changes the flow, sediment and fish life hundreds of kilometres downstream in another. For this reason, decisions about rivers made in isolation often create disputes that last for generations. Basin-level planning, in which all users share data and agree on allocations during both normal and dry years, offers a better path than repeated litigation.

questions.q: What does the author recommend?
o: Basin-level planning with shared data and agreed allocations
questions.x: Answer: 'Basin-level planning with shared data and agreed allocations'. The last sentence recommends basin-level planning. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Rivers do not recognise administrative borders. A dam built in one State changes the flow, sediment and fish life hundreds of kilometres downstream in another. For this reason, decisions about rivers made in isolation often create disputes that last for generations. Basin-level planning, in which all users share data and agree on allocations during both normal and dry years, offers a better path than repeated litigation.

questions.q: 'Deshbandhu' was the title of:
questions.x: Correct answer: Chittaranjan Das. He co-founded the Swaraj Party.

questions.q: The Cripps Mission (1942) offered:
o: Dominion status after the war with the right of provinces to opt out
questions.x: Correct answer: Dominion status after the war with the right of provinces to opt out. Gandhi called it 'a post-dated cheque'.

questions.q: The newspaper/journal 'The Bengalee' is associated with:
o: Barindra Kumar Ghosh and Bhupendranath Dutta
questions.x: 'The Bengalee' was started/edited by Surendranath Banerjee.

questions.q: 'Purna Swaraj Day' was first celebrated on:
questions.x: The Lahore Congress had adopted complete independence as its goal in December 1929.

questions.q: Choose the correct year for this event: the Shimla Conference convened by Lord Wavell failed.
questions.x: The Shimla Conference convened by Lord Wavell failed in 1945. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: The book 'India Wins Freedom' was written by:
questions.x: 'India Wins Freedom' was written by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad.

questions.q: Who among the following accompanied Gandhi in the Champaran Satyagraha?
questions.x: Correct answer: Rajendra Prasad. Others included Mazharul Haq, J. B. Kripalani and Narhari Parikh.

questions.q: Who founded the Indian Association (1876)?
questions.x: The Indian Association (1876) was founded by Surendranath Banerjee.

questions.q:
In which year did the following take place?
The Ilbert Bill controversy arose.
questions.x: The Ilbert Bill controversy arose in 1883. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: The 1888 session of the Indian National Congress, presided over by George Yule, was held at:
questions.x: It was held at Allahabad; it was the first session presided over by an Englishman.

questions.q: The military exercise 'Indra' is conducted between India and:
questions.x: 'Indra' is a bilateral exercise between India and Russia.

questions.q: 'Jan Aushadhi Kendras' sell:
o: Quality generic medicines at affordable prices
questions.x: They are run under the Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana.

questions.q: 'Project Cheetah' involved translocation of cheetahs from Namibia and South Africa to:
questions.x: Correct answer: Kuno National Park, Madhya Pradesh. The first eight cheetahs arrived in September 2022.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Smart Cities Mission and AMRUT were both launched in 2015.
2. AMRUT is primarily focused on rural drinking water.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Statement 1 is correct; Statement 2 is incorrect.
AMRUT focuses on urban water supply and sewerage; Jal Jeevan Mission covers rural tap water.

questions.q: The Chenab Rail Bridge, inaugurated in June 2025, is notable as:
o: The world's highest railway arch bridge
questions.x: Correct answer: The world's highest railway arch bridge. It is part of the Udhampur–Srinagar–Baramulla Rail Link.

questions.q: The current Chief of Defence Staff of India (appointed in 2022) is:
questions.x: Correct answer: General Anil Chauhan. Gen. Bipin Rawat was the first CDS.

questions.q: The 'Global Tuberculosis Report' is published by:
o: FAO with IFAD, UNICEF, WFP and WHO
questions.x: 'Global Tuberculosis Report' is brought out by World Health Organization.

questions.q: 'Feminisation of agriculture' refers to:
o: Rising share of women in the agricultural workforce as men migrate to non-farm jobs
questions.x: Correct answer: Rising share of women in the agricultural workforce as men migrate to non-farm jobs. Women often lack land titles and access to credit.

questions.q: 'Gaganyaan' is India's programme for:
questions.x: Correct answer: Human spaceflight. Uncrewed test flights precede crewed missions.

questions.q: Which day is observed on 15 January?
questions.x: 15 January is Army Day.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Special leave to appeal by the Supreme Court"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 136.

questions.q: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
o: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
questions.x: In the absence of the CJI, the senior-most Supreme Court judge administers it.

questions.q: Gram Nyayalayas were established under an Act of Parliament passed in:
questions.x: Correct answer: 2008. They provide access to justice at the grassroots.

questions.q:
Match the feature of the Indian Constitution with the source from which it was borrowed:
Feature:
A. Fundamental Rights
B. Directive Principles
C. Parliamentary government
D. Concurrent List
Source:
1. United States
2. Australia
3. Ireland
4. United Kingdom
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.x:
Correct matching — A (Fundamental Rights) → 1 (United States); B (Directive Principles) → 3 (Ireland); C (Parliamentary government) → 4 (United Kingdom); D (Concurrent List) → 2 (Australia).
Also: emergency provisions from Germany (Weimar), procedure for amendment from South Africa, federation with strong Centre from Canada.

questions.q: Which of the following is a Fundamental Duty under Article 51A?
o: To develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform
questions.x: Correct answer: To develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform. Voting and paying taxes are not listed as Fundamental Duties.

questions.q: In which case did the Supreme Court decriminalise consensual same-sex relations between adults by reading down Section 377 IPC?
o: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India (2018)
questions.x: Navtej Johar overruled Koushal; NALSA recognised transgender persons as a third gender.

questions.q: The 'Staff Selection Commission' and the 'UPSC' differ in that the SSC is:
o: A non-constitutional body (attached office of DoPT)
questions.x: Correct answer: A non-constitutional body (attached office of DoPT). UPSC is under Article 315; SSC was set up by a resolution in 1975.

questions.q: Which of the following Union Territories has a Legislative Assembly?
questions.x: Delhi, Puducherry and Jammu and Kashmir have legislatures.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Protection of interests of minorities (language, script, culture)"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 29.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Early childhood care and education for children below six years"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 45.

questions.q: The 'poverty line' in India has traditionally been defined in terms of:
questions.x: The Tendulkar and Rangarajan methods estimated consumption thresholds.

questions.q: Special Drawing Rights (SDR) are international reserve assets created by the:
questions.x: The SDR basket includes the US dollar, euro, Chinese renminbi, yen and pound.

questions.q: India's next Census, which will include caste enumeration, has its reference date fixed as:
questions.x: Correct answer: 1 March 2027 (1 October 2026 for snow-bound areas). It will be India's first digital census; houselisting begins in 2026.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): Agriculture's share in India's GDP has declined over decades.
Reason (R): Agriculture still employs the largest share of India's workforce.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: A is true and R is true, but R does not explain A. Both are true, but R does not explain A (structural transformation does).

questions.q:
In which year did the following happen?
The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority (IRDA) was established by an Act.
questions.x: The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority (IRDA) was established by an Act in 1999.

questions.q: Open Market Operations (OMO) refer to:
o: Purchase and sale of government securities by the RBI
questions.x: Correct answer: Purchase and sale of government securities by the RBI. Buying securities injects liquidity; selling absorbs it.

questions.q: Which committee/body is associated with "Restructuring of the Food Corporation of India"?
questions.x: Shanta Kumar Committee (2015) dealt with restructuring of the food corporation of india.

questions.q: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan, launched in October 2021, is aimed at:
o: Integrated planning of multimodal infrastructure using a GIS-based digital platform
questions.x: It brings 16 ministries onto one platform for coordinated project planning.

questions.q: A fixed deposit pays 7% per annum while inflation is 3%. Using the Fisher approximation, the real rate of interest is about:
questions.x:
Fisher approximation: real rate ≈ nominal rate − inflation = 7 − 3 = 4%.
(Exact: (1.07/1.03 − 1) × 100 ≈ 3.88%.)

questions.q: The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (2016) caps farmers' premium for kharif crops at:
questions.x: Correct answer: 2% of the sum insured. It is 1.5% for rabi and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.

questions.q: A computer server is purchased for ₹2,35,000 and ₹6,000 is spent on its installation. Its estimated useful life is 4 years with a residual value of ₹4,000. Annual depreciation under the Straight Line Method is:
questions.x:
SLM depreciation = (Cost + installation − residual value) / useful life.
= (2,35,000 + 6,000 − 4,000) / 4 = 2,37,000 / 4 = ₹59,250 per year.
Installation is capitalised as part of cost (AS 10 / Ind AS 16).

questions.q: Cash deposited into the bank is recorded as:
o: Cash A/c Dr. To Bank A/c
Bank A/c Dr. To Cash A/c
Bank A/c Dr. To Capital A/c
Capital A/c Dr. To Cash A/c
questions.x: This is a contra entry recorded on both sides of a two-column cash book.

questions.q: Opening inventory is ₹70,000, closing inventory is ₹50,000 and cost of goods sold for the year is ₹4,80,000. The inventory turnover ratio is:
questions.x:
Average inventory = (70,000 + 50,000) / 2 = ₹60,000.
Inventory turnover = COGS / Average inventory = 4,80,000 / 60,000 = 8 times.

questions.q:
Match the Accounting Standard (AS) with its subject:
Standard:
A. AS 2
B. AS 3
C. AS 10
D. AS 26
Subject:
1. Valuation of inventories
2. Property, plant and equipment
3. Intangible assets
4. Cash flow statements
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.x:
Correct matching — A (AS 2) → 1 (Valuation of inventories); B (AS 3) → 4 (Cash flow statements); C (AS 10) → 2 (Property, plant and equipment); D (AS 26) → 3 (Intangible assets).
AS 2 inventories, AS 3 cash flows, AS 10 PPE, AS 26 intangibles.

questions.q: A product sells at ₹50 with a variable cost of ₹40 per unit. Fixed costs are ₹49,000. The break-even sales (in ₹) are:
questions.x:
P/V ratio = Contribution/Sales = 10/50 = 20%.
BEP sales = Fixed cost / P/V ratio = 49,000 / 0.2 = ₹2,45,000.

questions.q: The profits of a firm for the last 4 years were ₹30,000, ₹42,000, ₹23,000, ₹57,000. Goodwill is to be valued at 4 years' purchase of the average profit. Goodwill is:
According to the realisation (revenue recognition) concept, revenue is ordinarily recognised when:
o: Goods are transferred or services rendered and the right to receive consideration arises
questions.x: Revenue is recognised on transfer of control/performance, not merely on cash receipt.

questions.q: The current ratio of a company is 1.75 : 1 and its working capital is ₹48,750. Its current assets amount to:
questions.x:
Let current liabilities = x. Then current assets = 1.75x and working capital = 1.75x − x = 0.75x.
0.75x = 48,750 → x = ₹65,000.
Current assets = 1.75 × 65,000 = ₹1,13,750.

questions.q: Discount allowed to a debtor at the time of receiving payment is:
o: Debited to Discount Allowed A/c as a loss
questions.x: Cash discount allowed is an expense; trade discount is not recorded in books.

questions.q: The Companies Act, 2013 prescribes useful lives of assets for depreciation in:
questions.x: Schedule II deals with useful lives; Schedule III with the format of financial statements; Schedule VII with CSR activities.

questions.q: Quick ratio excludes which of the following from current assets?
questions.x: Correct answer: Inventory and prepaid expenses. Quick assets are those readily convertible to cash.

questions.q: A trader's capital at the beginning of the year was ₹3,50,000 and at the end ₹3,92,500. During the year he introduced fresh capital of ₹25,000 and withdrew ₹12,500 for personal use. His profit for the year is:
questions.x:
Profit = Closing capital + Drawings − Additional capital − Opening capital
= 3,92,500 + 12,500 − 25,000 − 3,50,000 = ₹30,000 (statement of affairs method).

questions.q: The cash book of a firm shows a debit (bank) balance of ₹62,000. Cheques issued but not yet presented: ₹6,000; cheques deposited but not yet credited: ₹4,500; bank charges debited only in the pass book: ₹150. The balance as per the pass book is:
questions.x:
Start with cash book balance ₹62,000.
+ Cheques issued not presented (bank has not yet paid) 6,000
− Cheques deposited not credited 4,500
− Bank charges 150
Pass book balance = ₹63,350.

questions.q: Closing stock appearing in the trial balance (after adjustment through purchases) is shown:
o: In both the trading account and the balance sheet
In the profit and loss account
questions.x: If closing stock is already in the trial balance, it has been adjusted and goes only to the balance sheet.

questions.q: The appropriate authority for certifying standing orders under the earlier Standing Orders Act was the:
questions.x: The Certifying Officer adjudicated on the fairness of draft standing orders; the IR Code retains a certifying mechanism.

questions.q: A worker who is placed under suspension pending inquiry is entitled under the IR Code to subsistence allowance of what share of wages for the first ninety days?
questions.x: Subsistence allowance is 50% of wages for the first 90 days and 75% thereafter if the delay is not attributable to the worker.

questions.q: The Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act was passed by the legislature in the year:
questions.x: The Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act was enacted in 2008.

questions.q: The Indian Labour Conference, the apex tripartite consultative body in India, first met in:
questions.x: The ILC (originally the Tripartite Labour Conference) first met in 1942; the Standing Labour Committee is its smaller body.

questions.q: The Supreme Court decision in B. Shah v. Presiding Officer, Labour Court (1977) concerned:
o: Computation of maternity benefit including Sundays
questions.x: The Court held that maternity benefit is payable for all days in the benefit period, including Sundays, to ensure the woman's maintenance.

questions.q: The ILO Convention on Violence and Harassment, the first international treaty on the subject, is numbered:
questions.x: C190 was adopted at the ILO's centenary conference in 2019; C189 concerns domestic workers.

questions.q: The Directive Principle that the State shall endeavour to secure a 'living wage' and conditions of work ensuring a decent standard of life is in:
questions.x: Article 43 refers to a living wage, decent standard of life and full enjoyment of leisure; Article 42 deals with just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief.

questions.q: The ILO Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work was adopted in:
questions.x: The 1998 Declaration binds all members to respect fundamental principles regardless of ratification; it was amended in 2022.

questions.q: From January 2025 the PLFS methodology was revamped to provide which new output?
o: Monthly estimates of key labour indicators in Current Weekly Status
questions.x: The revamped PLFS releases monthly bulletins (CWS) for rural and urban areas, plus quarterly estimates for rural and urban India.

questions.q: Under the Code on Wages, the employer may make deductions from wages for all the following EXCEPT:
o: Income tax payable by the employee
Penalties imposed by the employer without any notified act or omission
Fines for acts and omissions specified with prior approval
questions.x: Fines are allowed only for acts/omissions notified with prior approval; arbitrary penalties are not authorised deductions.

questions.q: The main difference between arbitration and adjudication of industrial disputes in India is that:
o: Arbitration is voluntary by agreement of parties, while adjudication is compulsory by reference of the government
Adjudication is done by trade unions
questions.x: Arbitration rests on a written agreement of the parties; adjudication by Tribunals follows a government reference or direct application.

questions.q: The Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976 implements which Article of the Constitution?
questions.x: Article 23 prohibits traffic in human beings, begar and other forms of forced labour; the 1976 Act operationalises this prohibition.

questions.q: Overtime work under the Code on Wages must be paid at a rate of at least:
o: One and a half times the normal rate
Twice the normal rate of wages
questions.x: Section 14 mandates overtime at not less than twice the normal rate of wages.

questions.q: Under the OSH Code, an inter-State migrant worker is entitled to an annual lump-sum amount for:
o: A to-and-fro journey to the native place
questions.x: Section 60 provides an annual journey allowance for travel to the worker's native place and back.

questions.q: Under PM-SYM, the minimum assured monthly pension after attaining 60 years is:
questions.x: The subscriber gets ₹3,000 per month from age 60; the spouse gets 50% as family pension.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Labour Codes:
1. Every employer must issue an appointment letter to each employee.
2. Gig and platform workers are defined in a central labour law for the first time.
3. Fixed-term employment is recognised with benefits on par with permanent workers.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.x:
3 of the 3 listed items satisfy the condition asked.
All three are features of the Codes: appointment letters are mandatory under the OSH Code, gig/platform workers are defined in the Code on Social Security, and the IR Code recognises fixed-term employment with parity of benefits.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Social security in India is a Concurrent List subject.
2. Article 41 is a Directive Principle that refers to public assistance in old age and sickness.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Statement 1 is correct; Statement 2 is correct.
Entry 23 of the Concurrent List covers social security; Article 41 is a DPSP.

questions.q: ESI coverage generally applies to non-seasonal factories and notified establishments employing at least:
questions.x: The threshold is 10 persons; States have extended coverage to shops, hotels, educational and medical institutions with 10 or more.

questions.q: A member who leaves service with less than 10 years of EPS service can:
o: Transfer the amount to the employer
Take a withdrawal benefit or retain a scheme certificate to carry service forward
questions.x: Withdrawal benefit is computed using Table D; a scheme certificate preserves service for future pension.

questions.q: A woman employee returning from maternity leave is entitled to how many nursing breaks a day until the child is 15 months old?
questions.x: Two nursing breaks are allowed in addition to rest intervals.

questions.q: An employee retires after 13 years and 9 months of continuous service. Last drawn monthly wages (basic + DA) are ₹72,000. Gratuity payable under the statutory formula (non-seasonal establishment) is:
questions.x:
Gratuity = 15/26 × last drawn wages × completed years of service.
9 months is more than six months, so it counts as a full year → 14 years.
= 15/26 × 72,000 × 14 = ₹5,81,538 (well within the ₹20 lakh ceiling).
The divisor 26 reflects working days in a month.

questions.q: The maximum statutory gratuity payable (since March 2018) is:
questions.x: The 2018 amendment empowered the Centre to notify the ceiling; it was set at ₹20 lakh from 29 March 2018.

questions.q: The Executive Committee of the CBT, EPF is constituted under:
questions.x: Section 5AA creates the Executive Committee to assist the CBT.

questions.q: A 'social protection floor', as promoted by the ILO, guarantees at least:
o: Access to essential health care and basic income security for children, working-age persons and older persons
questions.x: Correct answer: Access to essential health care and basic income security for children, working-age persons and older persons. ILO Recommendation 202 (2012) sets out these basic guarantees.

questions.q: NPS Vatsalya, launched in September 2024, is meant for:
o: Minors, with parents/guardians contributing until the child turns 18
questions.x: Parents open an account for a minor (minimum ₹1,000 a year); it converts to a regular NPS account at 18.

questions.q: An eligible employee earns ₹17,500 per month. The notified minimum wage for the employment is ₹9,500 per month. If the establishment declares bonus at 15%, the annual bonus payable is (statutory computation):
questions.x:
For computing bonus, salary is capped at ₹7,000 or the minimum wage, whichever is higher: max(7,000, 9,500) = ₹9,500.
Salary for computation = min(17,500, 9,500) = ₹9,500.
Annual bonus = 9,500 × 12 × 15% = ₹17,100. Bonus must lie between 8.33% and 20%.

questions.q: An employee who joins with monthly wages above ₹15,000 and was not already an EPF member is:
o: An 'excluded employee', who may join voluntarily with the employer's consent
questions.x: Para 2(f) of the EPF Scheme treats such a person as excluded, though membership is possible by joint request.

questions.q: The first old-age pension scheme in India at the state level was introduced by:
questions.x: Uttar Pradesh introduced a non-contributory old-age pension in 1957; other States followed.

questions.q: Newton's first law of motion is also called the law of:
questions.x: A body continues in its state of rest or uniform motion unless acted upon by a net external force.

questions.q: Which of the following has the fastest access time?
questions.x: Correct answer: CPU registers. Memory hierarchy: registers > cache > RAM > SSD/HDD.

questions.q: Double helix structure of DNA is credited to:
questions.x: Double helix structure of DNA: James Watson and Francis Crick.

questions.q: Which abbreviation stands for 'Magnetic Ink Character Recognition'?
questions.x: Magnetic Ink Character Recognition is abbreviated as MICR.

questions.q: Which gland is known as the 'master gland'?
questions.x: Correct answer: Pituitary. It controls other endocrine glands.

questions.q: CaCO₃ (calcium carbonate) is commonly known as:
questions.x: CaCO₃ (calcium carbonate) is marble / limestone.

questions.q: Which instrument is used to measure very high temperatures?
questions.x: Pyrometer measures very high temperatures.

questions.q: 'Biomagnification' refers to:
o: Increasing concentration of toxic substances at higher trophic levels
Use of magnifying glasses in biology
questions.x: Correct answer: Increasing concentration of toxic substances at higher trophic levels. DDT and mercury biomagnify in food chains.

questions.q: The point on the Earth's surface directly above the origin of an earthquake is the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Epicentre. The Richter and moment magnitude scales measure earthquake magnitude.

questions.q: In MS Excel, the function to add a range of cells is:
questions.x: Correct answer: =SUM(). =AVERAGE(), =MAX(), =MIN() and =COUNT() are other common functions.

questions.q: The 'ozone layer' protects life on Earth by absorbing:
questions.x: Correct answer: Ultraviolet radiation from the Sun. CFCs deplete ozone; the Montreal Protocol (1987) phases them out.

questions.q: Which of the following file extensions indicates a compressed archive?
questions.x: Correct answer: .zip. .jpg is an image format and .exe an executable.

questions.q: Find the odd one out among 182, 65, 237 and 234.
questions.x: 234, 65, 182 are all multiples of 13; 237 is not. Hence 237 is the odd one out.

questions.q: The average age of 36 trainees in a batch is 16 years. When the instructor's age is also included, the average rises by 1 year. The instructor's age is:
questions.x:
Total of trainees = 36 × 16 = 576.
With instructor: 37 × 17 = 629.
Instructor = 629 − 576 = 53 years.

questions.q: The marks of students are: 11, 68, 66, 53, 21, 48, 22. Their arithmetic mean is:
questions.x: Sum = 289; number of values = 7. Mean = 289/7 = 41.29.

questions.q: The ratio of the present ages of P and Q is 7 : 5. After 13 years, the ratio will become 27 : 23. What is P's present age?
Find the volume of a cylindrical water tank of radius 14 m and height 18 m. (Take π = 22/7)
questions.x:
V = πr²h = (22/7) × 14 × 14 × 18 = 11088 m³.
(Curved surface 2πrh would be 1584 m² — a common mix-up.)

questions.q: In a certain code language, PLANT is written as SIDKW. How is SHARE written in that code?
questions.x:
Compare PLANT → SIDKW: P→S, L→I, A→D…
Rule: letters in odd positions move 3 forward and letters in even positions move 3 backward.
Applying it to SHARE gives VEDOH.

questions.q: There are 68 names in a merit list. Rahul's name is 19th from the top. What is its position from the bottom?
questions.x: Position from bottom = Total − position from top + 1 = 68 − 19 + 1 = 50.

questions.q: Gita starts from point O and walks 23 km towards South, then turns right and walks 24 km, then turns right and walks 28 km, and finally turns right and walks 12 km. What is the shortest distance and direction of the final position from O?
questions.x:
Take O as origin, North/East positive.
North–South: -23 +28 = 5 km → 5 km North.
East–West: -24 +12 = -12 km → 12 km West.
Distance = √(12² + 5²) = 13 km, towards North-West.

questions.q: In what ratio must tea costing ₹70 per kg be mixed with tea costing ₹230 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹122 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (230 − 122) : (122 − 70) = 108 : 52 = 27 : 13.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: The difference between the compound interest (compounded annually) and the simple interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 8% per annum is ₹25.60. The sum is:
A invests ₹40,000 for the whole year and B invests ₹25,000 after 2 months. If the annual profit is ₹36,500, B's share is:
questions.x:
Profit is shared in the ratio of capital × time.
A: 40,000×12, B: 25,000×10 → 48 : 25.
B's share = 25/73 × 36,500 = ₹12,500.

A box contains 8 red, 5 blue and 2 green tokens. Two tokens are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
questions.x:
Ways to choose 2 red = C(8,2) = 28; ways to choose any 2 = C(15,2) = 105.
P = 28/105 = 4/15.
